feedback_driven.quote: Guided by dataset metadata and validation feedback, TabFM-Auto iteratively refines data cleaning, feature engineering, context selection, and post-processing to reduce TabFM's error.

persists_across_tasks.quote: The discovered pipelines also transfer to other frozen tabular foundation models (+69 to +143 Elo) with no further search.

data.why_zh: 冻结 TabFM 模型，智能体根据验证反馈迭代改进数据流水线，且流水线可迁移复用。
